label: GO step early in the episode (first ~20 trials)
explanation: An early-episode timer unit. 89% of activation mass is at GO steps, and it fires only in the first ~30 trials of an episode: firing rate is about 23% of steps on trials 0-9, 11% on 10-19, 2.5% on 20-29, and zero from trial 40 on. Magnitude also falls with episode trial; the predicate covers 95% of top-quartile activations but only 52% of the lowest quartile. Smaller secondary firing at D2 when S2 is shown (about 10% of mass); it never fires when S1 is shown or when the reward input is 1 (so almost never at D1). Within early GO steps, adding conditions on the choice (a2 is favoured about 1.7x), previous reward, stay, value or policy confidence did not improve F1. Precision is limited (about 0.36) because many early GO steps stay silent. No future variables are used. Dev: P 0.36, R 0.70, F1 0.47, mass recall 0.83.
